content:
Apple officially released the watchOS 27.0.1 update for Apple Watch today. The company stated that this update fixes an issue where some Apple Watch devices would unexpectedly restart. This update is only available for Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 users.

The following are the complete release notes for watchOS 27.0.1:

On Reddit and other discussion forums, some Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 users reported that their new watches would randomly restart multiple times daily. Although the issue does not affect all users, there is clearly a bug, and it is hoped that this software update will fix it.

Has your Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4 encountered any issues? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
